narrative:

This raises concerns about your financial stability. Second, the duration of your credit request is notably longer than average, at 48 months, which can indicate a need for more time to repay, potentially signaling financial strain. Lastly, your credit history shows that you have existing paid credits, but this is less reassuring than the more favorable histories seen in many approved applicants.

These factors combined led to the conclusion that you may not be in the best position to manage additional debt responsibly. To improve your chances for future applications, consider enhancing your financial profile. Taking these steps can help demonstrate your creditworthiness and increase your chances of approval next time.
